spine.zh: 物价新高与英伟达改组

influence.en: Wallstreetcn breakfast (16 November). Friday closes, October credit, October producer prices, and the oil-market surplus.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻早餐（11月16日）。周五收盘、10月信贷、10月生产者价格，以及石油市场转为供应过剩。

influence.en: US Treasury curve for 13 November. The 2-year yield is 4.88%, the 10-year is 5.15%, and the 30-year is 5.47%. On 12 November they were 4.86%, 5.10%, and 5.43%.

keySources.label: 财新 港交所债券指数

influence.en: Caixin (16 November). Hong Kong Exchanges launched its first bond index, a benchmark for offshore yuan bonds, and it can back ETFs.
influence.zh: 财新（11月16日）。港交所推出首个债券指数，衡量离岸人民币债券，并可挂钩ETF。

influence.en: Caixin morning brief (16 November). Twelve APEC economy leaders are due at the business leaders' summit.
influence.zh: 财新早知道（11月16日）。12位APEC经济体领导人将出席工商领导人峰会。

influence.en: 16 November 财经早茶. The Treasury secretary wants a new Nvidia leadership, Brent was about flat, and the chart ranks a fully diluted value against US company market values.
influence.zh: 11月16日财经早茶。财政部长希望英伟达换一套领导层，布伦特大致持平。图把一个完全摊薄估值和美国公司市值放在一起。

influence.en: BlockBeats (15 November), citing CoinGecko. Bitcoin fell below 64,000 dollars, and total crypto market value fell to 2.27 trillion dollars, down 3.7% in 24 hours.
influence.zh: 律动（11月15日）引述CoinGecko。比特币跌破64,000美元，加密货币总市值降至2.27万亿美元，24小时下跌3.7%。

influence.en: BlockBeats (16 November). Nvidia grey-market shares rose more than 4% at one point after reports that Jensen Huang may return.
influence.zh: 律动（11月16日）。有报道称黄仁勋可能回归之后，英伟达暗盘一度上涨超过4%。

influence.en: BlockBeats (16 November). This week's focus is Nvidia's results, the Anthropic offering, and the Federal Reserve minutes and speeches.
influence.zh: 律动（11月16日）。本周焦点是英伟达业绩、Anthropic的发行，以及美联储纪要和官员讲话。

influence.en: BlockBeats (15 November). Binance's ether reserves are at a low not seen since 2021.
influence.zh: 律动（11月15日）。币安的以太坊储备降到2021年以来的低位。

keySources.label: 华尔街见闻 中俄美会晤

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (16 November), citing Xinhua. Xi, Putin, and Trump meet in Shenzhen on 19 November.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月16日）引述新华社。11月19日习近平、普京和特朗普在深圳会晤。

influence.en: Glassnode (11 November). Stablecoin supply fell 14.2 billion dollars over 30 days.
influence.zh: Glassnode（11月11日）。稳定币供给30天减少142亿美元。

title.en: US company values, with one fully diluted bar at the bottom
title.zh: 美国公司市值，底部有一根完全摊薄估值的条

analysis.en: Yellow bars are market value in trillion dollars. Apple is labeled 5.2. Two bars are labeled 3.9, then Alphabet 3.6, Amazon 2.9, SpaceX 1.9, Meta and Broadcom 1.7, and Tesla 1.5. The pink bar is a fully diluted potential value labeled 1.4. These figures are the labels on the chart.
analysis.zh: 黄条是市值，单位是万亿美元。苹果标成5.2。有两根标成3.9，然后Alphabet是3.6，亚马逊2.9，SpaceX 1.9，Meta和博通1.7，特斯拉1.5。粉色条是完全摊薄口径的潜在估值，标成1.4。这些数字是图上的标签。

marketTone.en: US stocks fell on Friday, and the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.15% after October producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier. On the chart, a fully diluted bar is labeled 1.4 trillion dollars, below the yellow market-value bars.
marketTone.zh: 美股周五下跌。10月生产者价格同比上涨6.5%之后，10年期国债收益率报5.15%。图上，一根完全摊薄的条标成1.4万亿美元，低于黄色的市值条。

text.en: The S&P 500 fell 0.40% to 7561.67, the Nasdaq fell 0.91% to 25136.273, and the Dow rose 0.10% to 52347.55, 华尔街见闻 reported.
October producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier, below the 6.6% forecast and above September's 6.3%, and rose 0.3% on the month, below the 0.4% forecast, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：10月生产者价格同比上涨6.5%，低于6.6%的预测，高于9月的6.3%；环比上涨0.3%，低于0.4%的预测。

text.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.88%, the 10-year is 5.15%, and the 30-year is 5.47%. On 12 November they were 4.86%, 5.10%, and 5.43%.
December WTI fell 0.20% to 88.56 dollars and January Brent rose 0.02% to 95.84 dollars. Brent is down nearly 19% over two weeks, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌0.20%至88.56美元，1月布伦特上涨0.02%至95.84美元。布伦特两周下跌近19%。

text.en: COMEX November gold futures rose 0.03% to 3879.7 dollars an ounce and stayed under 4000 dollars. The contract is down more than 4.5% on the week, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 11月黄金期货上涨0.03%至每盎司3879.7美元，仍在4000美元下方。该合约全周下跌超过4.5%。

text.en: Shanghai fell 0.59% to 3634.35, Shenzhen fell 2.05% to 10968.79, and the ChiNext index fell 3.32% to 2426.08, 华尔街见闻 reported.

October social financing rose by 1.15 trillion yuan, down from 3.55 trillion yuan in September, and renminbi loans fell by 100 billion yuan after rising 1.08 trillion yuan in September, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：10月社会融资增加1.15万亿元，低于9月的3.55万亿元。人民币贷款减少1000亿元，9月为增加1.08万亿元。

text.en: Bitcoin broke below 6.8 on the ten-thousand-dollar scale at one point on Friday, 华尔街见闻 reported. 律动, citing CoinGecko, said bitcoin fell below 64,000 dollars on 15 November.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：比特币周五一度跌破6.8万美元。律动引述CoinGecko：11月15日比特币跌破64,000美元。

signal.en: US stocks fell on Friday, Nvidia's weekly drop was the largest in a year and a half, and the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.15%. October producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier, below the 6.6% forecast. Brent was nearly flat at 95.84 dollars. Shanghai fell to 3634.35, and October social financing rose 1.15 trillion yuan, down from 3.55 trillion yuan in September. On the chart, the fully diluted bar is labeled 1.4 trillion dollars.
signal.zh: 美股周五下跌，英伟达的周跌幅是一年半来最大的，10年期国债收益率报5.15%。10月生产者价格同比上涨6.5%，低于6.6%的预测。布伦特基本持平，报95.84美元。上证跌至3634.35。10月社会融资增加1.15万亿元，9月为3.55万亿元。图上，完全摊薄的条标成1.4万亿美元。

watch.en: China publishes October activity data at 10:00 Beijing, including industrial output, retail sales, and fixed investment. Barr speaks at 18:00, Williams at 22:05, and Chair Warsh at 01:00 Beijing on 17 November. Xi, Putin, and Trump meet in Shenzhen on 19 November.
watch.zh: 中国10月经济活动数据在北京时间10:00公布，包括工业增加值、社会消费品零售和固定资产投资。巴尔18:00讲话，威廉姆斯22:05，主席沃什在11月17日01:00讲话。11月19日习近平、普京和特朗普在深圳会晤。

title.en: US stocks fell, and Nvidia's weekly drop was the largest in a year and a half
title.zh: 美股下跌，英伟达周跌幅是一年半来最大的

fact.en: The S&P 500 fell 0.40% to 7561.67, the Nasdaq fell 0.91% to 25136.273, and the Dow rose 0.10% to 52347.55, 华尔街见闻 reported. Nvidia fell 2% on the day and about 13% on the week, the largest weekly drop in a year and a half, and 律动 said grey-market shares rose more than 4% at one point.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：标普500下跌0.40%至7561.67，纳斯达克下跌0.91%至25136.273，道指上涨0.10%至52347.55。英伟达当天下跌2%，全周约13%，是一年半来最大的周跌幅。律动：暗盘一度上涨超过4%。

mechanism.en: Friday's index move was smaller than Nvidia's drop for the week, and the argument is over who runs the company. 财经早茶 (16 November): the Treasury secretary said the leadership needs a major overhaul and an outside chief executive. US equities fell, and the grey-market shares moved the other way on the return reports.
mechanism.zh: 周五指数的跌幅小于英伟达这一周的跌幅，争论的是谁来管这家公司。财经早茶（11月16日）：财政部长说，领导层需要大换血，首席执行官要从外面找。美股下跌，暗盘则因为回归的报道往另一个方向动。

title.en: The 10-year yield is 5.15% after a four-year high in producer prices
title.zh: 生产者价格创四年高位之后，10年期收益率报5.15%

fact.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.88%, the 10-year is 5.15%, and the 30-year is 5.47%, up from 4.86%, 5.10%, and 5.43% on 12 November. October producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier, below the 6.6% forecast and above September's 6.3%, and rose 0.3% on the month, below the 0.4% forecast, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 美国财政部：2年期收益率4.88%，10年期5.15%，30年期5.47%，11月12日分别为4.86%、5.10%和5.43%。华尔街见闻：10月生产者价格同比上涨6.5%，低于6.6%的预测，高于9月的6.3%；环比上涨0.3%，低于0.4%的预测。

mechanism.en: The 10-year yield moved from 5.10% to 5.15% even though producer prices came in below the forecast. Bank of America (16 November): the next moves are three increases in a row. Treasury yields rose, and the 10-year yield rose more than the 2-year yield.
mechanism.zh: 生产者价格低于预测，10年期收益率还是从5.10%升到5.15%。美银（11月16日）：接下来会连续三次升息。国债收益率上升，10年期升得比2年期多。

title.en: Brent was nearly flat on Friday after a two-week drop
title.zh: 布伦特周五基本持平，此前两周下跌

fact.en: December WTI fell 0.20% to 88.56 dollars and January Brent rose 0.02% to 95.84 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported. Brent is down nearly 19% over two weeks.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌0.20%至88.56美元，1月布伦特上涨0.02%至95.84美元。布伦特两周下跌近19%。

mechanism.en: Friday's settle barely moved after a two-week drop of nearly 19%. 财经早茶 (16 November): traders were weighing mixed signals on talks with Iran, including a strike on Bahrain and a hint that further attacks could pause. The two crude contracts barely moved on the day.
mechanism.zh: 两周下跌近19%之后，周五的结算几乎没动。财经早茶（11月16日）：交易员在权衡美伊谈判的矛盾信号，包括对巴林的袭击，以及进一步攻击可能暂缓的暗示。这两个原油合约当天几乎没动。

title.en: November gold edged up and stayed under 4000 dollars
title.zh: 11月黄金小幅上涨，仍在4000美元下方

fact.en: COMEX November gold futures rose 0.03% to 3879.7 dollars an ounce and stayed under 4000 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported. The contract is down more than 4.5% on the week. The Market snapshot shows Yahoo's gold futures quote, a different quote from this November settle.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 11月黄金期货上涨0.03%至每盎司3879.7美元，仍在4000美元下方。该合约全周下跌超过4.5%。行情快照展示的是Yahoo黄金期货报价，和这一11月合约结算不是同一报价。

mechanism.en: November gold rose 0.03% and is still under 4000 dollars after a weekly drop of more than 4.5%. 财经早茶 (16 November): the bounce in gold was small. The move is in COMEX November gold futures.
mechanism.zh: 11月黄金上涨0.03%，全周下跌超过4.5%之后仍在4000美元下方。财经早茶（11月16日）：黄金的反弹很小。变动在COMEX 11月黄金期货。

title.en: A-shares fell as October financing dropped from September

fact.en: Shanghai fell 0.59% to 3634.35, Shenzhen fell 2.05% to 10968.79, and the ChiNext index fell 3.32% to 2426.08, 华尔街见闻 reported. October social financing rose by 1.15 trillion yuan, down from 3.55 trillion yuan in September, and renminbi loans fell by 100 billion yuan after rising 1.08 trillion yuan in September.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证下跌0.59%至3634.35，深证成指下跌2.05%至10968.79，创业板指下跌3.32%至2426.08。10月社会融资增加1.15万亿元，9月为3.55万亿元。人民币贷款减少1000亿元，9月为增加1.08万亿元。

mechanism.en: A-shares fell while new financing dropped from September's 3.55 trillion yuan to 1.15 trillion yuan. 财经早茶 (16 November): the financing figure was below the forecast, and industrial output and retail sales are expected to slow. A-shares fell with that weaker credit print.
mechanism.zh: 新增融资从9月的3.55万亿元降到1.15万亿元，A股下跌。财经早茶（11月16日）：这个融资数字低于预测，工业增加值和零售销售增速料将放缓。信贷偏弱，A股跟着下跌。

title.en: COMEX November copper fell to a four-month low

fact.en: COMEX November copper fell 1.67% to 6.0795 dollars a pound, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 11月铜下跌1.67%至每磅6.0795美元。

mechanism.en: Copper fell on a day when January Brent barely moved. 华尔街见闻 (16 November): November copper is at a four-month low after five down weeks. The price is the COMEX November contract.
mechanism.zh: 1月布伦特几乎没动的这一天，铜下跌了。华尔街见闻（11月16日）：11月铜处在四个月低位，已经连跌五周。这个价格是COMEX 11月合约。

title.en: London tin surged on tight supply
title.zh: 伦敦锡价因供应偏紧而飙升

fact.en: London tin surged and buyers are facing tight supply, while gold's bounce was small, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：伦敦锡价飙升，买家面临供应制约，黄金只是小幅反弹。

mechanism.en: Tin jumped because supply is tight, while gold only steadied. 财经早茶 (16 November): buyers are the ones facing that constraint. Tin is the metal that jumped.
mechanism.zh: 锡价跳升是因为供应紧，黄金只是稳住。财经早茶（11月16日）：面对这个制约的是买家。跳升的是锡。

title.en: A fully diluted value of 1.4 trillion dollars sits below Tesla on the chart
title.zh: 图上1.4万亿美元的完全摊薄估值低于特斯拉

fact.en: The chart labels Apple at 5.2 trillion dollars, two companies at 3.9, Alphabet at 3.6, Amazon at 2.9, SpaceX at 1.9, Meta and Broadcom at 1.7, Tesla at 1.5, and a fully diluted bar at 1.4 trillion dollars. 财经早茶 reported that the Anthropic offering is set to exclude investors in mainland China and Hong Kong.
fact.zh: 图上苹果标成5.2万亿美元，两家公司标成3.9，Alphabet 3.6，亚马逊2.9，SpaceX 1.9，Meta和博通1.7，特斯拉1.5，完全摊薄的条是1.4万亿美元。财经早茶：Anthropic的发行据悉把中国内地和香港的机构投资者排除在外。

mechanism.en: The pink bar is a fully diluted potential value, and 1.4 trillion dollars would sit just under Tesla's 1.5. 财经早茶 (16 November): mainland and Hong Kong institutions are set to be left out of the offering. US equities are the market that would have to take a listing of that size.
mechanism.zh: 粉色条是完全摊薄口径的潜在估值，1.4万亿美元刚好在特斯拉的1.5之下。财经早茶（11月16日）：中国内地和香港的机构据悉进不了这次发行。美股要承接的是这个体量的上市。

title.en: European government bonds had their worst week in two months
title.zh: 欧洲主权债创两个月来最差单周

fact.en: UK and European government bonds had their worst week in two months as traders added to rate-increase bets, and European stocks closed at a record, the best week since July, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：英国和欧洲主权债创下两个月来最差单周，交易员加码加息押注。欧洲股市收于历史新高，是7月以来最好的一周。

mechanism.en: Bond prices fell on the week while stocks set a record, so the rate bets showed up in the bonds. 财经早茶 (16 November): the Bundesbank president said the ECB is likely to raise rates again. European government bonds took that rate move.
mechanism.zh: 这一周股价创了纪录，债券价格下跌，所以加息押注体现在债券上。财经早茶（11月16日）：德国央行行长说，欧洲央行很可能需要再次加息。承受这一变化的是欧洲主权债。

title.en: Bitcoin fell below 64,000 dollars over the weekend

fact.en: Bitcoin broke below 6.8 on the ten-thousand-dollar scale at one point on Friday and was more than 5% under the day's high, 华尔街见闻 reported. 律动, citing CoinGecko on 15 November, said bitcoin fell below 64,000 dollars and total crypto market value fell to 2.27 trillion dollars, down 3.7% in 24 hours. Over 30 days stablecoin supply fell 14.2 billion dollars, Glassnode reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：比特币周五一度跌破6.8万美元，较当日高点下跌超过5%。律动引述CoinGecko，11月15日：比特币跌破64,000美元，加密货币总市值降至2.27万亿美元，24小时下跌3.7%。Glassnode：稳定币供给30天减少142亿美元。

mechanism.en: The break below 6.8 and the later quote under 64,000 dollars are two times of one selloff. Glassnode (11 November): holders are redeeming stablecoins for dollars, and supply fell 14.2 billion dollars over 30 days. Bitcoin fell.
mechanism.zh: 跌破6.8万美元和后来跌到64,000美元下方，是同一次下跌的两个时点。Glassnode（11月11日）：持有人在把稳定币赎回成美元，供给30天减少142亿美元。比特币下跌。

text.en: The S&P 500 fell on Friday. Nvidia had its largest weekly drop in more than 18 months.
text.zh: 标普500指数上周五收跌。英伟达创逾18个月来最大单周跌幅。

text.en: The Golden Dragon index rebounded after four down days. Yum China and JD contributed the most.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数四连跌后反弹。百胜中国和京东集团对指数贡献最大。

text.en: US Treasuries were mixed on Friday, and the yield curve steepened.
text.zh: 美国国债上周五涨跌不一，收益率曲线陡化。

text.en: The Bloomberg dollar index rose for a fourth day to an 18-month high as Fed officials signaled further rate increases.
text.zh: 彭博美元指数四连涨，创下18个月以来新高。美联储官员密集释放加息信号。

text.en: UK and European government bonds had their worst week in two months as traders added to central-bank rate bets. European stocks closed at a record, their best week since July.
text.zh: 英国和欧洲主权债创下两个月来最差单周表现，市场大幅加码对央行加息的押注。欧洲股市收于历史新高，创下7月以来最佳单周表现。

text.en: Brent crude futures were roughly flat as traders weighed mixed signals on US-Iran talks.
text.zh: 布伦特原油期货基本持平，交易员研判有关美伊和平谈判走向的矛盾信号。

text.en: London tin surged as buyers face tight supply. Gold bounced a little.
text.zh: 伦敦现货锡价飙升，买家面临供应制约。黄金小幅反弹。

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

globalRegime.en: US stocks fell on Friday while producer prices stayed at a four-year high and officials kept pointing to another rate increase. Crude was little changed as talks and a surplus story arrived together. A-shares fell with a smaller October financing print.
globalRegime.zh: 美股周五下跌。生产者价格停在四年高位，官员仍在指向再次加息。谈判和供应过剩的说法同时出现，原油变动不大。10月融资少于9月，A股下跌。

text.en: Fed officials signaled further tightening. A 25 basis point increase in December is the likely case, and the chance of 50 basis points is about 15%, 华尔街见闻 reported. 财经早茶 said Bank of America expects three increases in a row.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：美联储官员释放进一步收紧的信号。12月加息25个基点是大概率情形，押注50个基点的概率约15%。财经早茶：美银预计接下来会连续三次升息。

text.en: October producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier, the highest since November 2022, below the 6.6% forecast and above September's 6.3%. The month rose 0.3%, below the 0.4% forecast, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：10月生产者价格同比上涨6.5%，为2022年11月以来最高，低于6.6%的预测，高于9月的6.3%。环比上涨0.3%，低于0.4%的预测。

text.en: The Fed's financial stability report said equity valuations remain high, in part because of expectations for superintelligence, and that this is a vulnerability, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：美联储金融稳定报告称，股票估值仍然偏高，部分来自对超级智能的预期，这是一项脆弱性。

text.en: Euro-area growth is resilient enough that the Bundesbank president said another ECB increase is likely, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：欧元区经济的韧性为欧洲央行进一步加息留出空间。德国央行行长表示，欧洲央行很可能需要再次加息。

text.en: Treasury secretary Bessent said Nvidia's leadership needs a major overhaul and that the board should look outside for a chief executive. The Financial Times reported that Jensen Huang is discussing a return, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：财政部长贝森特说，英伟达领导层需要重大重组，首席执行官应从公司外部寻找。英国《金融时报》报道，黄仁勋正在讨论重返公司。

text.en: Nvidia said it has not formally contacted any chief executive candidate and is still choosing a search firm. Reports said the board approached Arm chief executive Haas, and Arm shares fell 4.8%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：英伟达说尚未正式接触任何首席执行官候选人，正在遴选猎头。报道称董事会接触了Arm首席执行官Haas，Arm美股下跌4.8%。

text.en: Representative Moolenaar said Jensen Huang has agreed to closed-door testimony, and the time is not set. The House Democratic leader said Democrats will investigate the Nvidia scandal and its national security impact, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：众议员Moolenaar说，黄仁勋已同意闭门作证，时间仍待敲定。众议院民主党领袖表示，民主党将调查英伟达相关丑闻及其对国家安全的影响。

text.en: A nationwide ground stop on Friday delayed or cancelled more than 10,000 flights after an air-traffic communications failure, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：周五空管通信故障导致全国停飞，超过1万架次航班延误或取消。

text.en: Iran struck Bahrain for the first time since early September and said a path to end the conflict remains open. Reuters reported that the president may pause further attacks if there is no new provocation, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：伊朗9月初以来首次袭击巴林，并表示仍有希望结束冲突。路透报道，如果不再出现新的挑衅，总统考虑暂缓进一步攻击。

text.en: President Zelensky said a US envoy asked whether Ukraine would give the Donbas region to Russia in exchange for NATO membership, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：泽连斯基说，美国特使询问乌克兰是否愿意把顿巴斯地区让给俄罗斯，以换取加入北约。

text.en: The IEA cut its 2026 oil-demand forecast by 9 ten-thousand barrels a day to 1.0229 hundred million barrels a day. October supply rose by 230 ten-thousand barrels a day to 1.054 hundred million, the first month supply exceeded demand since the Middle East war, and observed stocks rose by 5200 ten-thousand barrels, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：国际能源署把2026年石油需求预测下调9万桶/日至1.0229亿桶/日。10月供应量增加230万桶/日至1.054亿桶/日，是中东战事以来供应首次超过需求。可观测库存增加5200万桶。

text.en: The administration is set to extend the Jones Act shipping waiver again, allowing foreign ships to carry oil and other commodities between US ports, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普政府据悉将再度延长《琼斯法》航运豁免，允许外国船只在美国港口之间运输石油等大宗商品。

text.en: Goldman strategists expect the S&P 500 to rise over the next 12 months and said the selloff left the largest cloud firms well below past valuations, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：高盛策略师预计标普500指数未来12个月上涨，并称近期抛售已令大型云服务商的估值远低于历史水准。

text.en: Morgan Stanley Wealth Management chief investment officer Lisa Shalett said the case built on AI infrastructure spending still holds, despite the Nvidia leadership turmoil and US politics, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：摩根士丹利财富管理首席投资官Lisa Shalett说，尽管英伟达领导层动荡、美国政治变化引发担忧，由人工智能基础设施资本支出驱动的逻辑仍然稳固。

text.en: Bessent said the Fed should not raise rates because of the energy shock from the Iran war, and that recent Treasury auctions and dollar demand have been strong, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：贝森特说，美联储不应因伊朗战争带来的能源冲击加息，并称近期国债拍卖强劲、美元买盘旺盛。

text.en: The October federal deficit was 404 billion dollars, up from 284 billion a year earlier. Interest spending over 12 months was 1.4 trillion dollars, 28.2% of tax revenue, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：10月联邦赤字4040亿美元，去年同期为2840亿美元。过去12个月利息支出1.4万亿美元，占税收的28.2%。

text.en: This week's focus is Nvidia's results, the Anthropic offering, and the Federal Reserve minutes and speeches, 律动 reported.
text.zh: 律动：本周焦点是英伟达业绩、Anthropic的发行，以及美联储纪要和官员讲话。

text.en: Binance's ether reserves are at a low not seen since 2021, 律动 reported.
text.zh: 律动：币安的以太坊储备降到2021年以来的低位。

text.en: If December pricing stays on a 25 basis point increase after a below-forecast producer-price print, the 10-year yield can stay above 5.15%.
text.zh: 若生产者价格已经低于预测、12月定价仍停在加息25个基点，10年期收益率可能维持在5.15%上方。

text.en: If another strike follows the one on Bahrain, Friday's flat crude settle could turn up. A longer surplus would lean the other way.
text.zh: 若巴林之后再有袭击，周五几乎持平的原油结算可能转涨。供应过剩拖得更久，则可能往另一边走。

text.en: A return by Jensen Huang would sit next to Friday's cash drop and the grey-market rise. Those are two prices, and they can move apart.
text.zh: 若黄仁勋回归，它会和周五的现金下跌以及暗盘上涨放在一起。这是两个价格，它们可以分开走。

globalTensions.en: Producer prices were below the forecast and still at a four-year high, and officials kept talking about tighter policy while Bessent said the energy shock is a reason not to raise rates. Brent was nearly flat after a strike on Bahrain and an oil-market surplus in the same week. A-shares fell while October financing was still positive.
globalTensions.zh: 生产者价格低于预测，仍是四年高位。官员继续谈论收紧，贝森特则说能源冲击是不加息的理由。同一周里，伊朗袭击了巴林，石油市场转为供应过剩，布伦特几乎持平。10月融资仍是正的，A股下跌。

chinaStance.en: October financing was smaller than in September, and loans fell. The securities regulator is studying how large technology listings are handled, and how quant trading and share-reduction rules should work.
chinaStance.zh: 10月融资少于9月，贷款下降。证券监管机构正在研究大型科技企业上市怎么安排，以及量化交易和减持规则怎么改。

text.en: October social financing rose by 1.15 trillion yuan, down from 3.55 trillion yuan in September. The stock of financing was 469.16 trillion yuan, up 7.2% from a year earlier, compared with 7.1% at the end of September. Renminbi loans fell by 100 billion yuan after rising 1.08 trillion yuan in September. M2 rose 7.1% and M1 rose 4.4%, and the gap narrowed to 2.7 percentage points from 4.0, 华尔街见闻 reported. 财经早茶 said the financing figure was below the forecast.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：10月社会融资增加1.15万亿元，9月为3.55万亿元。社融存量469.16万亿元，同比增长7.2%，9月末为7.1%。人民币贷款减少1000亿元，9月为增加1.08万亿元。M2同比增长7.1%，M1增长4.4%，剪刀差从4.0个百分点收窄到2.7个百分点。财经早茶：融资数字低于预测。

text.en: Xi, Putin, and Trump will meet in Shenzhen on 19 November, 华尔街见闻 reported, citing Xinhua.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻引述新华社：11月19日，习近平将同普京、特朗普在深圳会晤。

sources.label: 华尔街见闻 中俄美会晤

text.en: Bessent said the Treasury has supported putting Megaspeed on a trade blacklist for months and blamed Commerce secretary Lutnick for export-control gaps. He said chips do not need to be discussed at the leaders' meeting, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：贝森特说，财政部数月来支持把Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单，并指责商务部长卢特尼克未能堵住出口管制漏洞。他认为元首会晤没有必要讨论芯片问题。

text.en: After Taiwan prosecutors charged an Nvidia employee with helping to smuggle AI chips to mainland China, the company asked Taiwan officials for help, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：英伟达一名员工被台湾检方指控协助向中国大陆走私人工智能芯片之后，公司曾向台湾官员寻求协助。

text.en: The Anthropic offering is set to exclude institutional investors in mainland China and Hong Kong, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Anthropic的发行据悉把中国内地和香港的机构投资者排除在认购范围之外。

text.en: Hong Kong raised its full-year growth forecast, with the AI-driven export pickup as the reason, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：香港上调了全年经济增速预测，原因是人工智能热潮推动出口。

text.en: Hong Kong Exchanges on 16 November launched its first bond index, a benchmark for offshore yuan bonds in Hong Kong, and the index can back dim-sum bond ETFs, 财新 reported.
text.zh: 财新：港交所11月16日推出首个债券指数，衡量在港离岸人民币债券，并可挂钩点心债ETF。

sources.label: 财新 港交所债券指数

text.en: China wants faster upgrades of lithium-ion battery storage and wider use of sodium-ion batteries. CCTV said the entire increase in electricity use through 2030 is expected to be met by new clean generation, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国要求加快锂离子电池储能迭代，推广钠离子电池储能。央视称，到2030年新增用电量预计将全部由新增清洁能源发电满足。

text.en: New World Development plans a rights issue to shore up its balance sheet, and the founding Cheng family may take up most of the shares, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：新世界发展计划通过供股巩固资产负债表，创始人郑氏家族可能认购大部分股份。

text.en: CSRC chairman Wu Qing said the agency will study quant-trading and share-reduction rules, and how listing rules fit large new technology firms, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：证监会主席吴清说，将研究量化交易和减持规则，以及大型和新型科技企业发行上市的制度适配性。

text.en: Twelve APEC economy leaders will attend the business leaders' summit, 财新 reported.
text.zh: 财新：12位APEC经济体领导人将出席工商领导人峰会。

text.en: If October industrial output and retail sales slow, the smaller financing print gets a second reading the same morning.
text.zh: 若10月工业增加值和零售销售放缓，偏小的融资数字会在同一个上午得到第二组读数。

text.en: If the 19 November meeting in Shenzhen takes up chips, the Nvidia leadership fight and the export rules land in the same room.
text.zh: 若11月19日的深圳会晤谈芯片，英伟达的领导层之争和出口规则会碰到一起。

chinaDivergences.en: The ChiNext index fell 3.32% while Shanghai fell 0.59%. Social financing still rose, by 1.15 trillion yuan, while renminbi loans fell. Brent was nearly flat while COMEX November copper fell 1.67%.
chinaDivergences.zh: 创业板指下跌3.32%，上证下跌0.59%。社会融资仍增加1.15万亿元，人民币贷款则下降。布伦特几乎持平，COMEX 11月铜下跌1.67%。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 16 November, through next Friday, 27 November. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy meeting falls in these dates. After the November switch to standard time, a policy decision at 14:00 US Eastern would be 03:00 Beijing the next day. The minutes row has no clock in the source, so the time is not set.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月16日到下周五11月27日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息会议。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。纪要这一行的来源没有钟点，所以时间未定。

note.en: Equities, FX, gold futures, and Brent futures use the latest Yahoo daily bar; a session still open at the snapshot is intraday, not a close (Brent row is Yahoo BZ=F — not the same print as the CNBC settle); US Treasuries use the official daily yield curve (bp vs prior print); BTC is CoinGecko 24h change; funding compares adjacent OKX prints. Snapshot captured at generate time — not live on the page.
note.zh: 股票、外汇、黄金期货和布伦特期货采用 Yahoo 最近日线柱；快照时尚未收盘的时段是盘中，不是收盘（布伦特一行是 Yahoo BZ=F，与 CNBC 结算价不是同一报价）；美国国债采用官方日度收益率曲线（相对前值的基点）；比特币为 CoinGecko 的 24 小时变动；资金费率比较相邻的 OKX 报价。快照取自生成时点，不是本页实时行情。

printNote.en: The text cites the November COMEX settle at 3879.7 dollars, up 0.03% (华尔街见闻). This row is the Yahoo December futures quote.
printNote.zh: 正文引用的是COMEX 11月合约结算价3879.7美元，上涨0.03%（华尔街见闻）。这一行是雅虎12月期货报价。

printNote.en: The text cites January Brent at 95.84 dollars, up 0.02% (华尔街见闻). This row is the Yahoo futures quote.
printNote.zh: 正文引用的是1月布伦特95.84美元，上涨0.02%（华尔街见闻）。这一行是雅虎期货报价。

printNote.en: The text cites two earlier quotes, a Friday break below 6.8 on the ten-thousand-dollar scale (华尔街见闻) and a 15 November quote below 64,000 dollars (律动). This row is the CoinGecko 24-hour quote.
printNote.zh: 正文引用的是两个更早的报价，周五跌破6.8万美元（华尔街见闻），以及11月15日跌破64,000美元（律动）。这一行是CoinGecko的24小时报价。
